note: How Diodorus names each year of the game: by the archon at Athens, and the Olympiad when one was celebrated. 'year' is the BC year in which the game's year begins (autumn 405 is year 405). Diodorus' years run from midsummer and the game's from autumn, and Diodorus sometimes puts Sicilian events in the wrong year, so read each as 'about'. The chronicle shows these lines; they change nothing in play. Years 401, 400 and 399 are missing because Diodorus 14.19 to 14.40 is not among the saved texts (see docs/later.md).
